dimensions_mm.face_area_note: 593mm x 593mm = 0.3516 m² (gross face area; net open area may be slightly less due to media frame/septa)

rated_conditions.face_velocity_calculation: 3600 m³/h / 3600 s/h / 0.3516 m² = 2.845 m/s — consistent with manufacturer stated 2.84 m/s

delta_P_curve_points.confidence: CONFIRMED — manufacturer product page nominal data

delta_P_curve_note: ONE POINT ONLY — this is the manufacturer nominal rating condition. No multi-point ΔP curve was available from the source retrieved. Single-point linear extrapolation to other face velocities is possible but carries high uncertainty and must be labeled as an approximation.
terminal_delta_P_note: NOT STATED in source retrieved. Typical terminal ΔP for H13 filters is 375-500 Pa (literature value, not product-specific).
filter_class_ISO29463_note: ISO 29463 equivalent to EN 1822 H13. Confirmed from Freudenberg US product page (products.freudenberg-filter.com/en_US/detail/10893), Phase 12A.
efficiency_local_note: EN 1822-1:2019 H13 minimum local efficiency (scan test). Generic standard threshold, not product-specific measured value.
MPPS_diameter_note: Product-specific MPPS not published. Generic glass fibre HEPA range: 0.1–0.2 µm (Camfil, 2026-09-06) or 0.12–0.25 µm (CIBSE). EN 1822 test certificate shipped with each unit contains the actual MPPS for that production lot.
test_certificate_status: EXISTS — included with each filter unit per manufacturer product page. Not publicly accessible online. Must be obtained with physical purchase.
evidence_level_rationale: Official Freudenberg Filtration Technologies manufacturer product page. Airflow, face velocity, and initial ΔP confirmed from manufacturer data table. Single rated point only — no multi-point ΔP curve. ISO 29463 class confirmed from US product page. Phase 12A web search found no publicly accessible fractional efficiency curve, MPPS value, or multi-point ΔP data. Evidence B.

extrapolation_to_AQI_tower.tower_geometry_note: Assumes single 593x593mm filter installed with full face area open to flow. Actual tower cross-section from Phase 4 CAD model must be checked to confirm this filter fits and achieves this face area.
extrapolation_to_AQI_tower.delta_P_linear_calculation: 300 Pa × (1.197 / 2.84) = 300 × 0.421 = 126 Pa — LINEAR extrapolation from single rated point
extrapolation_to_AQI_tower.delta_P_uncertainty: HIGH. Single-point linear scaling is an approximation. Real filter ΔP at 1.19 m/s could be 80-150 Pa depending on actual ΔP-v relationship. Clean filter only — loaded filter will be higher.
